automation_evidence.quote:
We introduce EvoCast, a fully autonomous
research-agent system for iterative forecasting architecture evolution.

metric_evidence.quote:
EvoCast reduces the selected-baseline error on all three
tasks. It achieves the lowest MSE on all three tasks and the lowest
MAE on two of them.

summary: Automates forecasting architecture diagnosis, redesign, implementation and evaluation under a fixed protocol; it lowers MSE against baselines on three real tasks, and its system ablations concern research-loop reliability and cost rather than a time series obstacle.
